title: Children Are a Gift
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler who notices the people already in the room — she looked round a noisy dinner table and felt how precious her family is, which is exactly what Psalm 127 asks a household to do.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she cherishes the people in her home. In Willow’s world today: at dinner, Willow looked around at everyone laughing together and felt her heart go warm. “I’m so glad you’re my family,” she said, and gave her little brother a hug — even though he’d been silly all day. Just like the song about children being a gift from Heavenly Father, Willow felt how precious her family is.
